_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "pending_operations" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "payload" TEXT NOT NULL, "dedupe_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "tenant_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PENDING', "attempts" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "next_attempt_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "last_http_status" INTEGER NULL, "last_error_code" TEXT NULL, "last_error_message" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "depends_on" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "pending_uploads" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "local_file_path" TEXT NOT NULL, "storage_path" TEXT NOT NULL, "target" TEXT NOT NULL, "public_url" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "cache_metadata" ("scope" TEXT NOT NULL, "last_synced_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "record_count" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("scope"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "attendances" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "branch_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "membership_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "shift_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "clock_in" INTEGER NOT NULL, "clock_out" INTEGER NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "latitude" REAL NOT NULL, "longitude" REAL NOT NULL, "distance_to_branch_m" REAL NOT NULL, "worked_minutes" INTEGER NULL, "regular_minutes" INTEGER NULL, "overtime_minutes" INTEGER NULL, "justification_reason" TEXT NULL, "justification_status" TEXT NULL, "synced_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "shifts" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "start_time" TEXT NOT NULL, "end_time" TEXT NOT NULL, "grace_period_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "work_days" TEXT NOT NULL, "rest_days" TEXT NOT NULL, "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), "synced_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "branches" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "latitude" REAL NOT NULL, "longitude" REAL NOT NULL, "geofence_radius_m" REAL NOT NULL, "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), "synced_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "tasks" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "work_order_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "work_order_number" INTEGER NULL, "work_order_status" TEXT NULL, "vehicle_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "branch_id" TEXT NULL, "bay_id" TEXT NULL, "service_name" TEXT NULL, "mechanic_id" TEXT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "description" TEXT NOT NULL, "estimated_hours" TEXT NULL, "hold_reason" TEXT NULL, "missing_item_description" TEXT NULL, "pending_suspension_reason" TEXT NULL, "started_at" INTEGER NULL, "total_paused_seconds" INTEGER NOT NULL, "synced_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "work_orders" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "internal_number" INTEGER NULL, "branch_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "vehicle_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "customer_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "current_bay_id" TEXT NULL, "bay_name" TEXT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "diagnostic_summary" TEXT NULL, "mileage_in" INTEGER NULL, "subtotal" TEXT NULL, "tax_amount" TEXT NULL, "total_amount" TEXT NOT NULL, "currency" TEXT NOT NULL, "synced_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "bays" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "branch_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "bay_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "current_work_order_id" TEXT NULL, "synced_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "customers" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "display_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "tax_id" TEXT NULL, "email" TEXT NULL, "phone" TEXT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "synced_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "vehicles" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "plate" TEXT NOT NULL, "vin" TEXT NULL, "brand" TEXT NOT NULL, "model" TEXT NOT NULL, "year" INTEGER NULL, "engine_type" TEXT NULL, "current_owner_id" TEXT NULL, "current_mileage" INTEGER NULL, "synced_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "appointments" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "branch_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "customer_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "vehicle_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "scheduled_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "estimated_duration_minutes" INTEGER NULL, "reason" TEXT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "synced_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "parts" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "sku" TEXT NOT NULL, "category" TEXT NOT NULL, "base_price" TEXT NOT NULL, "total_stock" TEXT NOT NULL, "minimum_stock" TEXT NOT NULL, "unit_of_measure" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "synced_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "batches" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "item_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "batch_number" TEXT NOT NULL, "remaining_qty" TEXT NOT NULL, "unit_cost" TEXT NOT NULL, "arrival_date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "synced_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "vouchers" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "work_order_id" TEXT NULL, "voucher_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "serie" TEXT NOT NULL, "number" INTEGER NOT NULL, "total_amount" TEXT NOT NULL, "paid_amount" TEXT NOT NULL, "pending_balance" TEXT NOT NULL, "payment_status" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "pdf_url" TEXT NULL, "synced_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "telemetry_readings" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "vehicle_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "timestamp" INTEGER NOT NULL, "engine_temp_celsius" REAL NOT NULL, "engine_rpm" INTEGER NULL, "speed_kmh" INTEGER NULL, "battery_voltage" REAL NULL, "fuel_percentage" REAL NULL, "latitude" REAL NULL, "longitude" REAL NULL, "batch_operation_id" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "vehicle_faults" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "vehicle_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "dtc_code" TEXT NOT NULL, "severity" TEXT NOT NULL, "description" TEXT NOT NULL, "detected_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "is_resolved" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("is_resolved" IN (0, 1)), "resolved_at" INTEGER NULL, "synced_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "predictive_alerts" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "vehicle_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "alert_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "confidence_score" REAL NOT NULL, "message" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "synced_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "app_locks" ("name" TEXT NOT NULL, "owner" TEXT NOT NULL, "expires_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("name"));
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_pending_operations_dedupe_key ON pending_operations (dedupe_key)
CREATE INDEX idx_pending_operations_status_next_attempt_at ON pending_operations (status, next_attempt_at)
CREATE INDEX idx_pending_operations_user_id ON pending_operations (user_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_attendances_membership_id_clock_in ON attendances (membership_id, clock_in)
CREATE INDEX idx_tasks_work_order_id ON tasks (work_order_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_work_orders_branch_id_status ON work_orders (branch_id, status)
CREATE INDEX idx_bays_branch_id ON bays (branch_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_customers_tax_id ON customers (tax_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_vehicles_plate ON vehicles (plate)
CREATE INDEX idx_appointments_branch_id_scheduled_at ON appointments (branch_id, scheduled_at)
CREATE INDEX idx_parts_sku ON parts (sku)
CREATE INDEX idx_parts_category ON parts (category)
CREATE INDEX idx_batches_item_id ON batches (item_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_vouchers_work_order_id ON vouchers (work_order_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_telemetry_readings_vehicle_id_timestamp ON telemetry_readings (vehicle_id, timestamp)
CREATE INDEX idx_vehicle_faults_vehicle_id_dtc_code ON vehicle_faults (vehicle_id, dtc_code)
CREATE INDEX idx_predictive_alerts_vehicle_id_created_at ON predictive_alerts (vehicle_id, created_at)
